%.name: remainder
%.plain: a % b is the remainder a - b * (a / b), with the sign of a (-7 % 2 = -1); b = 0 gives NaN.
%.plain_zh: a % b 是余数，符号与 a 相同，b = 0 时得 NaN。

- (unary).name: negation
- (unary).plain: - a is the negation of a.
- (unary).plain_zh: - a 是 a 的相反数。

↟.name: rel parent
↟.plain: a ↟ is the parent of entity a in the supplied relation table; an absent edge gives NaN.
↟.plain_zh: a ↟ 是关系表里 a 的父母，没有这条记录时得 NaN。

↝.name: rel colleague
↝.plain: a ↝ is the colleague of entity a in the supplied relation table; an absent edge gives NaN.
↝.plain_zh: a ↝ 是关系表里 a 的同事，没有这条记录时得 NaN。

↔.name: rel neighbour
↔.plain: a ↔ is the neighbour of entity a in the supplied relation table; an absent edge gives NaN.
↔.plain_zh: a ↔ 是关系表里 a 的邻居，没有这条记录时得 NaN。

≟.name: rel equal
≟.plain: a ≟ b is true exactly when the two entity names are equal.
≟.plain_zh: a ≟ b 在两个名字相同时为真。
